$comment: Shared by src/app/core/manifest.spec.ts and scripts/lib/systems-lib.test.mjs. Each case validates { ...valid, ...patch }; a patch that is not an object replaces the whole manifest.

cases.name: not an object
expectedErrors: manifest is not an object

cases.name: empty text fields
expectedErrors: slug must be a non-empty string
name must be a non-empty string
tagline must be a non-empty string
description must be a non-empty string

cases.name: number
expectedErrors: number must be a number

cases.name: string arrays
expectedErrors: tags must be a string array
useCases must be a string array

cases.name: defaultMode
expectedErrors: defaultMode must be "light" or "dark"

cases.name: empty fonts and palette
expectedErrors: fonts must be a non-empty array
palette must be a non-empty array

cases.name: font entries
expectedErrors: fonts[0] needs family, role, weights, googleFontsUrl
fonts[1] needs family, role, weights, googleFontsUrl

cases.name: palette entries
expectedErrors: palette[0] needs token, light, dark, role
palette[1] needs token, light, dark, role

cases.name: allowedGradients not an array
expectedErrors: allowedGradients must be an array

cases.name: allowedGradients entries
expectedErrors: allowedGradients[0] needs pattern, reason
allowedGradients[1] needs pattern, reason

cases.name: typeScale missing
expectedErrors: typeScale must have ratio and steps

cases.name: typeScale null steps
expectedErrors: typeScale must have ratio and steps

cases.name: typeScale numeric step
expectedErrors: typeScale.steps values must be strings

cases.name: typeScale array steps
expectedErrors: typeScale.steps values must be strings

cases.name: rules
expectedErrors: rules must have do and dont string arrays

cases.name: components and pages not arrays
expectedErrors: components must be an array
pages must be an array

cases.name: component and page entries
expectedErrors: components[0] needs id, name, file, notes
pages[0] needs id, name, file
